prompt: Write the HOA incident report for the July 4th fireworks display that concluded with the Hendersons' shed no longer existing. Nobody is at fault.
response: INCIDENT REPORT — OAKWOOD ESTATES HOA. RE: July 4th Community Display / Henderson Shed (structure, former). SECTION 1 — SUMMARY. At approximately 2145 hours the finale concluded ahead of schedule when a mortar known commercially as 'The Yellowstone' was redirected by a gust of wind no forecast had any business missin'. SECTION 2 — FINDINGS. The tube was staked proper. The angle was verified by two separate dads. The wind, which is the responsibility of no man, shifted. Physics done the rest. SECTION 3 — THE SHED. The structure underwent a rapid unscheduled disassembly. The ridin' mower inside was thrown clear and started on the first pull afterward, which the committee notes as a testament to American engineering. SECTION 4 — FAULT. None. The committee finds the wind acted alone. SECTION 5 — RECOMMENDATION. Next year sites forty feet further out, and the Hendersons get the good pavilion parkin' through Labor Day. Respectfully submitted. God bless.
